description: The plot titled "Hidden State Mean" illustrates the average hidden state mean values across different layers of a model. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and ranges from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," is also linear and ranges from 0 to 4, with tick labels at intervals of 1. There are three lines in the plot, each representing a different condition. The dashed blue line represents the hidden state mean before a gate, with an average value of 0.71, and it remains relatively flat across the layers. The dotted orange line represents the hidden state mean after a gate, with an average value of 0.05, and it also remains flat across the layers. The solid green line represents the hidden state mean of the baseline, with an average value of 0.04, and it remains flat across the layers. There are no significant changes, peaks, declines, or steady trends observed in the plot.
